subject: Post-call: MAP data-accountability checklist — retention, logging & PHI/PII
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@aurelia-health.com>, Aurelia Procurement <procurement@aurelia-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: MAP data-accountability checklist — retention, logging & PHI/PII

Thanks for the call earlier, Ethan — good alignment on the primary objectives. Circling back with a concise MAP milestone draft focused on the data-handling items we discussed so your security and legal teams can review. I attached an editable MAP worksheet (AH-MAP-data-draft.xlsx) and our SOC2 summary for quick reference.

Key proposed milestones (owner -> target):
- "Define retention policy and legal clause" -> Aurelia (Procurement) -> target: 2027-01-10
- "Logging & audit trail spec (events, retention, access history)" -> Aurelia sec + Redwood security -> target: 2026-12-15
- "PHI/PII storage & encryption attestation" -> Redwood security -> target: 2026-12-08
- "Contract redlines pinned (retention, deletion, egress)" -> Aurelia legal & Redwood legal -> target: 2027-01-15

Dependencies we've flagged:
- Procurement PO (Aurelia) — required to begin Dedicated/Private onboarding
- Security questionnaire completion — triggers SOC2 docs exchange
- Decision on whether data will be processed in Redwood Private (VPC) vs Hosted (affects audit scope)

Quick asks / next steps:
1) Can Procurement confirm the internal owner for the retention clause (name + email) by EOD 2026-12-02?
2) Security: please confirm if Aurelia requires event-level logging (every API payload) vs aggregate logs — impacts cost/retention sizing.
3) I'll share a v2 of the MAP with owners pinned after we get confirmations.

Attachments: AH-MAP-data-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF stub)

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@aurelia-health.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Procurement <procurement@aurelia-health.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP data-accountability checklist — retention, logging & PHI/PII

Thanks, Rafael — appreciate the clear draft. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: for PHI-backed records we need a minimum 7-year retention for auditability, but the legal team will confirm if we can have tiered retention (7 years for full PHI, 2 years for derived embeddings).
- Logging granularity: our security lead prefers event-level logs for access and data access events (who/what/when) for the first 12 months, then aggregated thereafter. Will that be feasible from Redwood's side without breaking latency SLOs?
- On-prem/VPC: we are strongly evaluating Private (VPC) for initial pilot due to our compliance regime. Can you confirm what additional artifacts you provide for Private deployments (e.g., HSM/KMS attestations, network diagram, audit log export formats)?

We will loop in our security lead and legal next. Procurement note: we'll confirm the PO timeline after legal hooks the retention clause into the SOW.

Quote from your original message for context:
> "Dependencies we've flagged: Procurement PO (Aurelia) — required to begin Dedicated/Private onboarding"

Ethan Brooks
Director, Platform Security
Aurelia Health Systems
ethan.brooks@aurelia-health.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@aurelia-health.com>, Aurelia Procurement <procurement@aurelia-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP data-accountability checklist — retention, logging & PHI/PII

Thanks Ethan — good questions. Quick answers and commitments from Redwood: 

- Retention flexibility: Redwood can support tiered retention in the MAP (we will capture separate buckets for raw PHI, de-identified artifacts, and embeddings). We'll document retention enforcement points in the SOW.
- Logging: we can provide event-level access logs (who/what/when/resource) exported in NDJSON or Parquet. We recommend rolling 12-month hot retention and 2–5 year cold storage for audit copies — specifics to be agreed. Performance impact: negligible for our Dedicated and Private offerings; we'll include sizing guidance in the MAP.
- Private (VPC) artifacts: we will provide network diagrams, KMS integration checklist, HSM attestation summary (if requested under enterprise package), and audit-log export instructions. See attached SOC2 summary for current controls.

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with the owners and the specific deliverables (logging formats, retention buckets, DOC templates) and share the v2 link. Proposed updated milestone responsibilities (short):
- Aurelia legal: confirm retention buckets and redline clause -> due 2027-01-10
- Redwood security: deliver logging spec + export samples -> due 2026-12-15
- Redwood delivery: prepare Private onboarding checklist if Aurelia selects VPC -> due 2026-12-22

I dropped a shared Drive link into the MAP (see hubspot/drive links above). If Aurelia security can confirm whether they need HSM-level attestations vs KMS integration only, we'll mark that dependency.

Rafael
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
